description: This Java class 'ModuleTestData' appears to be a utility class intended for testing purposes within the OpenMRS project. It manages counters and timestamps for various module lifecycle events like refresh, start, and stop, and provides singleton access to its instance. The class is used to track the number of times certain actions occur per module, likely for testing or validation in unit tests.
